admin.connection_intro: Credentials of the Telegram bot that will receive notifications.
admin.chat_id_help: ID of the channel or group, e.g. -1001234567890 or @channelusername.
admin.proxy_help: Formats socks5://host:port or http://host:port, auth via user:pass@host:port. Requires cURL.
admin.use_proxy_help: Enable if api.telegram.org is unreachable from your server directly.
admin.use_topic_switch: Send messages to a specific topic
admin.use_topic_help: Enable this for forum-style Telegram groups where messages are organized into topics.
admin.topic_id_help: Numeric ID of the topic (message_thread_id) in the group.
admin.enabled_tags_help: Only notify about new discussions and replies in the selected tags. Leave empty to notify about everything.
admin.enabled_tags_empty: The flarum-tags extension must be enabled to choose tags.
admin.templates_intro: Customize how notifications look in Telegram. Telegram HTML formatting is supported.
admin.ex_full: full card with tags and excerpt
admin.ex_button: labeled link instead of a raw URL
admin.ph_excerpt: First ~200 characters of the post content
admin.hints_summary: Show placeholders, HTML tags and ready-made templates
admin.template_invalid_discussion: New discussion template has invalid HTML: {error}
admin.template_invalid_post: New post template has invalid HTML: {error}
admin.template_missing_href: {tag} tag must contain an href attribute
admin.test_sample_excerpt: This is a sample excerpt to preview how your template looks in Telegram.
admin.tag_link: link, {url} can be used in href
